scenario
value: How does an enterprise keep execution consistent across locations?

name: method
value: A linear throughput illustration with 120 equivalent work packages, 0.75 packages/person/week and an illustrative 24-week target. The fixed comparison uses 10 people, 65% availability, 24% rework and 23% dependency drag.

name: formula
value: Weekly rate = team × 0.75 × availability × (1−dependency drag)/(1+rework); duration = ceil(120/rate); schedule gap = 24−duration.

name: limits
value: This is not a critical-path or resource-loaded schedule. It has no real dependencies, holidays, cost model or uncertainty distribution. The chart horizon expands to include slow scenarios.
